div.div: A fog node decides where to run a task by cost: latency, energy and risk, where risk = 1 − trust of the target. A fast but untrusted node is never chosen. The task carries an attenuated capability, not the caller's full credential.

ul.li: risk is part of the cost, not a filter only: among trusted nodes the more trusted one still wins ties
hard floor from policy (execute-task needs trust ≥ 0.5) so the cost model cannot be tuned into an unsafe choice
capabilities make delegation least-privilege: fog-B cannot reuse the token elsewhere
measured: balancers on a skewed workload, table test + benchmark
